frozen_predictions.binding: exact artifact sha256 + cpu receipt sha256, never place name
frozen_predictions.scope: Predictions only. No game-label file is read, no fitting is performed, and no game agreement is claimed. Some oracle runs may already exist; this is not a claim that all predictions predate all observations.

limits: Reviewed directed-rail native path study, not accuracy, blind holdout, geographic negative or a place-level rail promise. Selected requests are a bounded sample at opening in this exact loaded-file and plugin context; a failed query or an empty candidate list is Unknown, never absence. Pittsburgh's fixed cap left 112 candidates unqueried and Boston's two same-edge successes are not distinct-edge witnesses. The four positive cells agree with the preserved frozen-v3 rail candidates by exact artifact hash and CPU receipt lineage; that is positive-witness agreement on an already observed cohort, not accuracy. Native raw receipts bind CRP bytes, not freshly rehashed prepared inputs: the three input hashes are reused frozen lineage. File identity is not in-memory code attestation or strict no-mods; dynamic assemblies are excluded and three DLC-panel errors are retained at every opening. enabled_mod_count=0 does not mean unloaded/no mods: CitiesBridge, the harness and built-ins are loaded. No rail service, train spawning, station/port, editor/gameplay parity, sustained gameplay or human play is established. No native rail certificate is issued and no live Yes is claimed.
method: Two fixed stock controls establish that this exact directed literal-boundary Train query can return a complete, released path whose first and last positions are the requested Outside offsets, that both controls carry reciprocal successes, and that a Train query to an explicit Car-but-not-Train lane is rejected. Only then does the unchanged nine-package geographic cohort run. Each opening freezes the full native network snapshot, endpoint/lane inventory and ordered requests before any query, then binds the actual executable and every resolved loaded-assembly file through the rendering process's namespace PID/start. Selected failures and unqueried candidates stay Unknown. Earlier selector revisions and repeats are retained as separate diagnostics, never pooled votes.

protocol.diagnostics: midpoint per selected directed pair; reverse first boundary without changing lanes (not assumed invalid); Train query from first boundary source to smallest Car-but-not-Train segment/lane at offset128 (invalid vehicle pair)
protocol.order: distinct-edge first, then lexicographic from/to [segment,lane,offset]; first 128 boundary requests
protocol.prediction: direction-compatible candidates, not predicted native successes; all finite misses remain Unknown
protocol.rule: source away from outside node, destination towards it; swap direction for segment Invert; test native Forward/Backward bits directly, not composite Avoid enum values or display names
protocol.scope: sampled_native_lane_paths_at_opening; file identity, not memory attestation or strict no-mods

selection.cohort_gate: both stock controls completed and bound; at least one exact directed literal-boundary success; each control rejects the invalid Train-to-Car query; freeze cohort enumeration only after this gate
selection.stock_rule: first two builtin corpus filenames lexicographically with metadata incoming/outgoing train > 0; no replacement after native inspection
